source_snapshot.procedure: Install NVCert environment using the NV Cert 3.4 x86 installation guide.
source_snapshot.criteria: Install and run without errors; NVIDIA reviews the result.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL; vendor harness and SKU configuration required; warns checks may change state.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: Require exact artifact/SKU/check manifest, dedicated SUT, recovery and NVIDIA disposition trail.

old_problem: NVCert was named only as a broad proprietary harness: artifact and guide identities, SKU profile, included/skipped checks, state-changing targets, per-check evidence, rollback and the authoritative NVIDIA acceptance response were unbound.
disposition_reason: The source purpose is explicit—install and run NVCert 3.4 for the approved SKU and obtain NVIDIA review. ED-03 permits vendor artifacts, SKU profile and check manifest as project prerequisites; ED-16 requires each hazardous check and recovery to be approved, while ED-14 preserves the 480/720-minute scope and ED-15 leaves the final verdict gated on NVIDIA's signed disposition.
decision_basis: Directly read Compatibility row378 all 18 XLSX columns, same-row DeepSeek material, GPT V2/history2971 and unique variant.
Treated NVCert as a vendor-controlled multi-check certification transaction, not a generic command whose installation success implies PASS.
Retained installation, full run, all in-scope checks, 480 attended/720 machine minutes and mandatory NVIDIA result review.
Directly read next formal queue Compatibility row379 and verified its manifest identity; no NVCert installation or DUT action ran.

test_case.test_name: NVCert 3.4 SKU-bound certification and NVIDIA disposition
test_case.purpose: Install the immutable NVCert 3.4 environment for the approved platform/SKU, execute every signed in-scope certification check with governed mutations and recovery, and obtain an attributable NVIDIA review disposition.
required_package: NVIDIA-provided NVCert 3.4 provenance/version/checksum/license and compatible stack matrix
Pinned `NV Cert 3.4 -install guide x86 2024 05 24 v1.pdf` plus install/run script hashes
Exact platform/SKU configuration, prerequisite inventory, complete included/skipped check manifest and skip authority
Per-check target, state-change/reboot/flash/storage/destructive classification, command, oracle, stop and recovery
Dedicated isolated SUT, backups, stable power/cooling, OOB access and 480/720-minute schedule
NVIDIA submission channel, immutable evidence bundle format, reviewer identity and acceptable disposition states
test_case.test_command: After artifact/SKU/check-manifest and change-control approval, capture immutable baselines and backups on the dedicated SUT; follow only the pinned NVCert 3.4 guide to install and run the allowlisted profile once across the full source time allocation, checkpoint every check and mutation, preserve complete outputs and platform telemetry, restore approved state, then submit the hashed evidence bundle to NVIDIA for disposition.
test_case.expected_result: The exact NVCert environment installs without error; every in-scope check executes with complete attributable output and satisfies its vendor oracle; no unapproved check or mutation occurs; platform health and configuration are restored; NVIDIA returns the approved review disposition for the matching evidence bundle.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: Installation or script exit success alone cannot pass certification. PASS requires every in-scope check, allowed-skip justification, complete evidence, restored health and an attributable NVIDIA disposition that the project defines as acceptance; absent or ambiguous vendor review remains unaccepted.
safety_gate: Dedicated isolated SUT, stable power/cooling and independent OOB recovery
Freeze artifact, SKU profile and every included/skipped check before execution; prohibit undeclared modules
Require separate authorization for any flash, destructive storage, power-cycle, fault-injection or other hazardous check
Preserve logs and prestate; stop at the first undefined mutation, target, oracle or recovery and never retry automatically
expected_evidence: Harness/license/checksum, guide and script hashes, SKU/stack compatibility and prerequisites
Signed included/skipped check manifest with mutation/risk/authorization/recovery per check
Installation transcript, full check outputs/exits, checkpoints and synchronized platform health telemetry
Pre/post configuration hashes, backup/rollback and final restored-health proof
Hashed NVIDIA submission bundle, ticket/reference, reviewer identity, timestamp and signed disposition
test_case.recovery: If installation or a check changes an unexpected target, fails, loses reachability or lacks a defined rollback, stop the harness without retry, preserve the checkpoint and system evidence, use OOB plus the check-specific approved recovery, restore from verified backups where authorized and quarantine the SUT until owners reconcile state.

source_conflict.reason: Procedure and Criteria consistently require NVCert 3.4 installation/run and NVIDIA review; absent artifact/profile details are governed prerequisites rather than contradictory requirements.

blocked.reason: Certification purpose, transaction boundaries, safety gates, evidence and final vendor disposition are defined; exact vendor package/profile remains an execution prerequisite.
